subject: Vendor RFP: Managed Sales Engagement Consolidation & Implementation
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@bluepeak.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@hubspot-partner.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RFP: Managed Sales Engagement Consolidation & Implementation

Hi Samantha / Alex —

We are kicking off an internal procurement for consolidating our sales engagement stack. Goal: reduce tool overlap, lower per-seat unit economics, and move to a single managed partner for implementation + ongoing ops for Outreach + HubSpot integration.

High level asks for your proposal:
- Fixed-cost implementation SOW for a three-month migration window
- Ongoing managed-services retainer (monthly) for routing, sequencing, and governance
- License rationalization plan: suggested seat counts, discounts, and transition credits
- A risk/rollback plan in case deliverables miss milestones

Attached is a one-page RFP outline and our current license mapping CSV. We are targeting vendor selection by Mar 12 and a PO issue by Mar 26.

Can you confirm if BluePeak / HubSpot partner team can respond with an initial SOW and commercials by Feb 26? If there are questions, loop me in.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Systems | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: 20270220-RFP-outline.pdf, license-mapping-csv-20270221.csv

From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@bluepeak.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Torres <alex.torres@hubspot-partner.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP: Managed Sales Engagement Consolidation & Implementation

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the RFP. BluePeak can absolutely respond within your timeline. Attached is a draft SOW that maps to the three-month migration and outlines the managed-services retainer options (bronze/silver/gold). A few quick clarifying questions before we finalize pricing:

1) Do you expect the migration to include historical sequence history migration into Outreach, or will sequences be rebuilt?
2) Will Redwood require playbook-level QA and A/B test support during rollout?
3) Are there internal SLAs for deliverable turnaround (e.g., security review/PO approval) that will affect our milestones?

We included an estimated level-of-effort and a line item for a temporary staging cluster if you want to avoid production churn. Pricing is ballpark until we confirm the sequence history decision.

I will follow up with a redline and final numbers by Feb 26.

Best,
Samantha Reed
VP, Customer Solutions | BluePeak Consulting
samantha.reed@bluepeak.com

Attachment: BluePeak-SOW-draft-20270223.docx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@bluepeak.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP: Managed Sales Engagement Consolidation & Implementation

Kim / team —

Quick notes from Product/Platform:
- We prefer to migrate historical sequences where feasible; losing play history will reduce forecasting fidelity.
- Platform will provide a one-week blackout window for data sync; BluePeak to confirm time estimate for catch-up processing.
- We need the SSO and SCIM integration tested in staging before the final cutover.

@Priyom can you flag any budget constraints? We want to avoid scope creep on the SOW.

- Marcus

On Wed, Feb 24, 2027 at 08:15 Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com> wrote:
> We have two possible procurement sources: centralized tools budget (preferred) or line-item from GTM ops. Central budget may require an internal approval meeting the week of Mar 1.
>
> Priyom Das
> Procurement Manager

From: contracts@outreach.com <contracts@outreach.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@bluepeak.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP: Managed Sales Engagement Consolidation & Implementation — Outreach commercial notes

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for considering Outreach for this consolidation. A few commercial items to note:
- We can provide transition credits for existing Outreach seats if contracts are active at cutover (we'll need contract IDs).
- Enterprise discount tiers apply at 250+ seats; there is a mid-tier pricing band we can quote for 75-249 seats.
- For managed-service partners, Outreach offers a partner enablement discount of 10% for the first 12 months if BluePeak is the implementation lead.

I've attached the standard addendum language. For faster turnaround, you can route PO approvals to contracts@outreach.com and we will triage.

Regards,
Outreach Licensing Team
contracts@outreach.com

Attachment: outreach-addendum-template.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@bluepeak.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@hubspot-partner.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP: Managed Sales Engagement Consolidation & Implementation

Team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Next steps:
1) Samantha: please send final SOW with two price bands (minimal sequence migration vs full history migration) and include the staging cluster line item. Target: Feb 26 COB.
2) Priyom: please open an internal requisition against centralized tools budget and request an approval meeting for Mar 1.
3) Marcus: coordinate with Platform to prepare the staging environment and list required test cases (SSO, SCIM, KV sync).

I'll consolidate commercials and route a recommended vendor to Legal the morning of Mar 2 for an expedited review. If Outreach can confirm transition credit details (contract IDs) that will speed negotiation.

Appreciate the team momentum —
Kimberly
